title.narrative: World Food Programme efforts in relation to food security in Ukraine 2022-2023

description.narrative: Contribute to the urgent improvement in food security in Ukraine.

This support through WFP will contribute to reducing food security through cash based transfers and in-kind modalities, contributing to address the sharp rise in humanitarian needs in Ukraine.
WFP is a trusted strategic partner to Denmark, an important humanitarian actor within food security. WFP is developing extensive operational presence in the country by increasing its own and overall humanitarian capacity. It is a critical actor for the food security response in Ukraine.
Due to its nature as a response to a humanitarian appeal operational results are general and highly aggregated and the MFA contribution is thus reflected in the overall results reporting by the partner. Please refer to the hyperlink below.
https://www.wfp.org/publications
